s1.syndrome_frame: A slowly growing eyelid mass with recent changes and crust formation
salient_findings: Yellowish-brown, well-circumscribed papule on the central lower eyelid
Flakier surface at one lateral end of the tumor
Hyperkeratotic lesion with pseudohorn cysts and neoplastic squamous cell proliferation
key_facts: 4-year history of a left lower eyelid mass
Recent growth and crust formation noted by the patient's wife
Tumor located on the central lower eyelid without margin involvement
Specimen measured 0.8 × 0.5 × 0.3 cm
Microscopic findings include hyperkeratotic lesion and pseudohorn cysts
Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli
Mitotic figures present
Central areas of clear cell change were periodic acid–Schiff positive and diastase sensitive
Negative results with Alcian blue and mucicarmine stains
Negative immunohistochemical stains for adipophilin and androgen receptor
